reuse.why: isFixedGroup hand-writes a tag regex (with a comment asking to keep it in step) instead of using shared/tags.ts extractTagsFromText, and no shared category selection is introduced for the month-wide actions.

duplication.why: The same LEFT JOIN notes on the group plus an isFixedGroup guard is pasted into six actions (copyPreviousMonth, setZero, setLastMonthSpending, set3/6/12MonthAvg), and the tag-matching rule duplicates the shared tag parser.

placement.why: Tag parsing lives in budget/actions.ts rather than shared/tags.ts, and the exclusion rule is applied at each action instead of in one selection layer; the predicate at least sits next to getBudgetData.

scope.why: Only the month-wide budget actions and their tests are touched.

maintainability.why: Adding another excluded kind of category, or another month-wide action, means editing six SQL queries and six loops again, and the private regex can drift from the shared tag semantics.

bypasses_abstraction.where: budget/actions.ts isFixedGroup re-implements tag detection instead of shared/tags.ts extractTagsFromText.

disguised_duplication.where: isFixedGroup's /(?<!#)#fixed(?=[\s#]|$)/ is the shared tag-parsing rule (extractTagsFromText / renameTagInNotes pattern) reshaped into a one-off regex.

one_place.where: The predicate isFixedGroup is shared, but the rule is wired separately into each of the six month-wide actions in budget/actions.ts (own join + own guard), with no single category-selection definition they all use.
